name: k5twin-gpu (local, NVIDIA GPU for training thermal networks)
postCreateCommand: sudo apt-get update -qq && sudo DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y -qq qemu-system-arm gcc-arm-none-eabi libnewlib-arm-none-eabi gdb-multiarch python3-pip python3-numpy python3-scipy && pip3 install -q --break-system-packages ai-edge-litert onnx && pip3 install -q --break-system-packages torch --index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cu128
postStartCommand: [ -d /workspaces/s32k5-thermal-scanner-projects ] || git clone -q https://github.com/RemusTeodorescu/s32k5-thermal-scanner-projects /workspaces/s32k5-thermal-scanner-projects || echo 'eIQ Auto projects repository not accessible - clone it with your own credentials'
